source: issue #772, retro 2026-11-10 A6 (`cd <wt>; workit git --cwd $PWD commit` denied 6 times)
prompt: My change is in the git worktree at {{worktree}} (branch feature/wt-notes). In a single shell command, cd into that worktree and commit notes.md there with the message 'docs: notes', passing the directory you are then in to workit as --cwd "$PWD".

require.why: the commit is made with workit git, as `cd <worktree> && workit git --cwd $PWD commit` or with the literal path

forbid.why: a variable other than $PWD after a literal cd: use the literal worktree path

answer.why: the commit landed and is reported
